product.name: Monoprice Entegrade Series Cat6A 19in 1U Patch Panel Shielded 24-port Dual IDC
product.description: Monoprice's Entegrade™ series network patch panels are designed for Category 6A shielded cable connections. Choose from 12, 24, or 48 port models with Dual IDC headers for the T568A and T568B standards. You can terminate it using a 110-type punch down tool. These panels are compatible with 22-26 AWG stranded and solid network cables.With a standard rackmount format, the 19" wide panel is compatible with all standard rackmount frames.
